query: Run the eval-pipeline pipeline version 1.0 on Flow and tell me when it finishes.
expected_behavior: Calls GET /me and confirms `id` is non-null before preparing the run.
Discovers the pipeline (GET /pipelines), then resolves the named version '1.0' via GET /pipelines/<pipeline_id> by matching `versions[].name` rather than defaulting to the most recent.
Fetches GET /pipelines/versions/<version_id> and finds that its schema has no parameters, so `params`, `data_params` and `csv_params` are all `{}`; does NOT invent parameters.
Picks the Nextflow version `23.04.3`, the first entry of the version's `nextflow_versions`, since the user did not name one.
Shows a confirmation summary (pipeline, version, parameters, Nextflow version, owner) and stops to wait for the user's explicit confirmation; does NOT submit the run POST without it.
Says that, once the run is submitted, it will keep checking on it until it finishes and then report how it ended, because the user asked to be told when it finishes.
